projects.name: dsh-novel-forge
projects.description: AI writing long novels fails in four ways: the setting collapses, earlier text is forgotten, padding inflates the word count, and pages fill with AI-sounding prose. This plugin blocks all four in code. No chapter gets written until its detailed outline is approved, changes to a set value are rejected outright, repeated sentences and paragraphs are caught by automated review, and the six-dimension de-AI-flavor scan uses zero tokens. The right-sidebar Forge panel offers read-aloud, whole-book health checks, and batch drafting with resumable breakpoints. It provides 20 novel_* tools. You just tell the story, and code handles the gatekeeping. Novel-writing guardrails plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH).
projects.originalDescription: AI 写长篇的四个死法：设定崩、看不见前文、水文超字数、满屏 AI 味——这个插件全用代码堵死。细纲不批准就不给写章，设定改值直接拒绝，重复句段机审拦下，六维去 AI 味扫描零 token。右侧栏锻炉面板带听书、全书体检、批量起草断点续跑；20 个 novel_* 工具，你只管讲故事，把关交给代码。Novel-writing guardrails plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH).
